args.body: Take SHOPIFY-CATALOGUE-TRANSFORMATION as one bounded delivery-fit test, not another generic validator or marketplace scan. Check the actual FETCH receipts before relying on files. The decisive question is whether a useful exact transformation is specified and deliverable through existing plain-text offline fulfillment. Do not infer willingness to pay from a pricing page or claim Shopify import compatibility without execution. If the official specification is inaccessible or the job depends on account access, stop without speculative implementation. Leave existing live sites unchanged.

description: Feedback has three unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Existing CSV evidence concerns mapping rather than structural checking. Test a specific catalogue-transformation service with authoritative specifications and paid-alternative evidence; preserve both live observation windows.
